messages.content: Before the deadline, compare the modified Drury studio, the restored one-bedroom there, and the nearby two-room suite. I need the exact bedding, parking, taxes, and when each one charges us.

The Drury studio remains $1,113 total: $873 room charge, $150 taxes and fees, and $90 parking. It has two queen beds in one open room, with breakfast and the evening reception included. Payment is due at checkout. The restored Drury one-bedroom is $1,499 total: $1,259 room charge, $150 taxes and fees, and $90 parking. It has one king bed in the bedroom and one sofa bed in the sitting room; the same meals and payment terms apply. The nearby Homewood two-room suite is $1,382 total: $1,097 room charge, $165 taxes and fees, and $120 parking. It has one king bedroom, a separate living room with a sofa bed, and breakfast. It requires a one-night deposit of $252 today, with the balance due at checkout.
So the Homewood is $269 more than the studio, but $117 less than restoring the Drury suite?
Correct. Those differences include all listed taxes, fees, and five nights of parking.
Does the Homewood sofa bed sleep two, and is the bedroom actually separated by a door?

Yes. The confirmed room description lists a queen-size sofa bed and a closing door between the king bedroom and living room. The reservation can be entered for three guests without an added-person fee.
What are its cancellation terms? I do not want to lose a deposit tonight if we change our minds tomorrow.

The $252 deposit is refundable if canceled by 6:00 p.m. St. Louis time tomorrow, March 15. After that, the deposit becomes nonrefundable. The Drury reservation also remains freely cancelable until that same time.
Replace the Drury reservation with the Homewood suite. Cancel the Drury only after the Homewood is confirmed, and tell me both confirmation results.

The Homewood two-room suite is confirmed for three guests from March 16 through March 21 under confirmation STL-HWS-74126. It guarantees one king bedroom with a closing door and a queen sofa bed in the living room. The complete total is $1,382.00, including $165.00 in taxes and fees and $120.00 for parking. A refundable $252.00 deposit was charged today; the balance is due at checkout. I then canceled Drury confirmation STL-DRY-58341, with no cancellation charge. Its cancellation reference is STL-DRY-C58341. With $175 estimated fuel and $50 for Fox and downtown parking, the revised trip base is $1,607.00 before other meals and activities.
